permissions.name: ALL
permissions.note: Super permission; combining ALTER+DROP+CREATE+DESCRIBE semantics on the resource.

permissions.name: CREATE_DATABASE
permissions.note: Catalog-level grant; lets the principal create databases in the data catalog.

permissions.name: CREATE_TABLE
permissions.note: Database-level grant required before table creation.

permissions.name: SELECT
permissions.note: Read grant; column-scoped when granted on table_with_columns, row-scoped when combined with a data_cells_filter.

permissions.name: INSERT
permissions.note: Write grant; on governed tables also requires the location grant for credentials vending.

permissions.name: DATA_LOCATION_ACCESS
permissions.note: Lets the principal create tables/databases whose location sits under a registered S3 path.

permissions.name: ALTER
permissions.note: Schema/metadata mutation grant; excludes data access.

permissions.name: DESCRIBE
permissions.note: Metadata visibility only; the minimum grant for a consumer account on a shared resource.

permissions.name: ASSOCIATE_TAG
permissions.note: Lets a principal attach an LF tag to resources - required for LF-TBAC authoring.

permissions.name: GRANT_WITH_LF_TAG_EXPRESSION
permissions.note: Grant by tag expression rather than named resource - the LF-TBAC path.
